Attention: Henry M. Yamanaka, Mobility Studies Engineer Wy
Re:
Mobility Studies, Lincoln Highway Improvement Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road, Cook County
Dear Mr. Yamanaka:
In regard to your letter dated July 8, 1971:
1. The property is located on the north side of Route 30, two blocks in length. The first block is between Franklin and Sunnyside Avenues and the second block is between Sunnyside and Prairie Avenues. The property is used for playstound area and the Roosevelt Elementary School Site. School District No. 170 of Chicago Heights, Illinois owns the property.
2. Block #1 between Franklin and Sunnyside Avenues.
Fencing and sidewalk the entire length on south side of property.
Fencing and sidewalk the entire width of property on the west and east sides.
Four small trees.
Block #2 between Sunnyside and Prairie Avenues.
Pedestrian underpass beneath Route 30.
Two large tree stumps.
Two full grown trees.
Two small trees.
Two Honeysuckle bushes.
Three sidewalks from school building to Route 30.
Sidewalk entire length of south boundary.
Sidewalk entire width of property on the west and east sides.
